item.title: Football Hackers: The Science and Art of a Data Revolution
item.description:
Overview of Football Hackers: The Science and Art of a Data Revolution

Summary

Football Hackers: The Science and Art of a Data Revolution by Christoph Biermann explores the transformative impact of data analytics on the world of football. The book delves into how data is revolutionizing strategies, tactics, player recruitment, and overall management within the sport. Through interviews with analysts, managers, and players, Biermann illustrates how clubs are harnessing data to gain competitive advantages. This narrative spans from the development of early statistical models to modern, sophisticated analytics systems used by top European clubs.
